calculation.description: For each tradable cross-asset instrument, measure the change in five-day momentum versus the five-day momentum 20 trading days earlier, normalize by trailing 20-day return volatility, and lag one completed day to avoid look-ahead. Higher values indicate improving trend impulse.

validation.regime_notes: 15-asset cross-sectional Spearman IC with at least 8 valid instruments/date; 2,431 valid 10-day observations and 15.0 average instruments. Uncertainty is material in this small universe; the signal is medium-horizon and relatively low turnover. Exact regime slice reporting was not available from the validation output, so monitor post-2026 behavior closely.

provenance.method: daily cross-sectional Spearman correlation; point-in-time lagged signal
